name: hidx_link_g4p-g4p-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-IDXPIPE 10-18: pipelined successor of idx_link (ot_hbm_idx_topk_link_static_p): historical 1-edge pack/carry/8-bank write (42 levels, 4,096-b runtime part-select, ~7k-load selects; hidx_link_pr never gateable) -> S1 8-lane group compaction + pair merge, S2 quad merge, S3 half merge, S4 loop (10-b total adder) + rotate into the 64-slot record ring, S5 registered bank-write formation with ring register W for partial flits; control delay line keeps the input timeline; every output exactly +5 edges (calendar --link-pipe 5, frame +5 edges). d4g slot 650x500; ONE clock root clk for every flop and the 8 SRAMs (clk_mem kept, unloaded). Banks 0-3 stack W (MY, core pins facing the centre), 4-7 stack E (R0), 264-um centre channel + S/N bands; S selected_line, N tx+controls, E clock. Benches run_link_pipe.sh: +5 miter vs the historical die master + gold records + fault path; MUT1-4 FAIL (V5.050).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_topk_link_static_p u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_topk_link_static_p.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: link_pipe_exact
bench.pass_regex: IDX_LINK_PIPE_TOTAL MUT0 records3072 miter1954 errors0 fillsff maxpack71 first_tx ref187 dut192 fault ref1954 dut1959
